# gpcn_vpc_public_ip_attachment (Resource)

Binds an elastic public IP address acquired with gpcn_vpc_public_ip to one VPC network interface. Destroying the attachment detaches the address and leaves it held by the VPC, so the address itself survives. GPCN allows one elastic address per machine. Requires the API-key permissions vpc:read and vpc-public-ip:update.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Attaching a GPCN VPC elastic public IP address to an interface

terraform {
  required_providers {
    gpcn = {
      source  = "Global-Private-Cloud-Network/gpcn"
      version = "~>1.4.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "gpcn" {
  host = "https://api.gpcn.com"
}

variable "vpc_id" {
  type = string
}

# The VPC network interface the address serves. A virtual machine's interfaces
# are listed in its network_interfaces attribute.
variable "nic_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "gpcn_vpc_public_ip" "example" {
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
}

# Destroying the attachment detaches the address and leaves it held, so the
# gpcn_vpc_public_ip resource above survives and can serve another interface.
resource "gpcn_vpc_public_ip_attachment" "example" {
  vpc_id       = var.vpc_id
  public_ip_id = gpcn_vpc_public_ip.example.id
  nic_id       = var.nic_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `nic_id` (String) Unique identifier of the VPC network interface the address is bound to. GPCN has no verb that re-points a live address, so changing this value requires replacing the attachment, which detaches the address and attaches it again. The platform reports the machine an address serves but not the interface, so an interface changed outside Terraform is not detected
- `public_ip_id` (String) Unique identifier of the address to attach. Changing this value requires replacing the attachment
- `vpc_id` (String) Unique identifier of the VPC that holds the address. Changing this value requires replacing the attachment

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the attachment (equal to public_ip_id, because an address carries at most one attachment)
- `virtual_machine_id` (String) Unique identifier of the virtual machine the attached interface belongs to
